tasks.title: Build the Aesop Academy synchronization engine.
tasks.description: Build the engine that will review curated YouTube videos and research Aesop Academy Courses with material related to those videos and link them on 25experts.com
tasks.plan:
## Overview

Build a Cloud Function-based synchronization engine that connects curated YouTube videos on 25experts.com to relevant Aesop Academy courses. For each video in the curatedVideos collection, the engine extracts learning concepts, queries the Aesop Academy course catalog, ranks matches by relevance, and stores the mappings in Firestore. Visitors see course links and descriptions right under each video, enabling seamless discovery of structured learning paths.

## Architecture

Videos and transcripts come from curatedVideos collection (pre-fetched by harvestVideos Cloud Function). Course catalog comes from Aesop Academy REST API (GET https://aesopacademy.org/aesop-api/catalog.php) with hash-based change detection. The sync engine orchestrates: transcript read → concept extraction (OpenAI CLI) → course matching (local semantic search) → ranking → Firestore write. Admin page displays unmatched videos and API status alerts.

## Phases

1. Setup & Foundation (Firestore schema, admin page structure, OpenAI CLI verification)
2. Video Analysis Pipeline (transcript reading, LLM concept extraction, title/description fallback)
3. Course Integration & Matching (API client with caching, semantic matching, ranking algorithm)
4. Sync Engine & Firestore (Cloud Function orchestration, videoId tracking)
5. Admin Interface & Error Handling (unmatched videos UI, API failure alerting)
6. Testing & Iteration (real video testing, algorithm refinement)

## Key Design Decisions

- Transcripts are pre-stored in curatedVideos collection (no YouTube API calls needed)
- Hash-based API caching: only re-fetch course catalog when hash changes
- Local course matching: rank algorithm runs in Cloud Function, not API
- videoId tracking prevents re-processing of already-synced videos
- Admin page surfaces unmapped videos as curriculum development opportunities
- Email alerts on API failures (to ravenshroud@gmail.com)

## Success Criteria

Firestore schema initialized; course catalog fetched and cached; YouTube transcripts extracted; concepts extracted via OpenAI; courses matched and ranked by relevance; Cloud Function syncs videos; admin page shows unmatched videos and API status; email alerts work; real video testing confirms ranking quality; all edge cases documented.

proofUnits.title: Firestore Schema Initialized
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: videoCourseMappings collection exists in Firestore with defined fields and can accept new documents
proofUnits.exactCommand: Firebase Console → Firestore → Collections: verify videoCourseMappings exists; create test document with videoId, courses, syncedAt, hasCourses fields
proofUnits.expectedInitialFailure: Collection does not exist or write fails
proofUnits.expectedPassingEvidence: Test document successfully created and queryable

proofUnits.title: Transcript Reader Fetches from Firestore
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: transcript-reader.js queries curatedVideos by videoId and returns transcript field
proofUnits.expectedInitialFailure: Function not found or cannot read transcript field
proofUnits.expectedPassingEvidence: All tests pass: valid videoId returns transcript, null/missing returns empty string, invalid videoId handled gracefully

proofUnits.title: LLM Concept Extraction Returns Concepts
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: concept-extractor.js takes transcript and returns comma-separated learning concepts via OpenAI CLI
proofUnits.expectedInitialFailure: Function not found or OpenAI CLI not configured
proofUnits.expectedPassingEvidence: All tests pass: sample transcript returns 3+ concepts, fallback analysis works, empty input handled

proofUnits.title: Aesop Academy API Client Fetches and Caches
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: API client calls GET https://aesopacademy.org/aesop-api/catalog.php, compares catalog_hash, re-fetches only if hash changed
proofUnits.expectedInitialFailure: Function not found or endpoint not reachable
proofUnits.expectedPassingEvidence: All tests pass: fetches catalog, extracts hash, caches on same hash, re-fetches on hash change, handles API failures

proofUnits.title: Course Matching & Ranking Works
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: course-matcher.js and relevance-ranker.js compare concepts against courses and return ranked list (0-1 scores, descending)
proofUnits.exactCommand: cd functions && npm test -- utils/course-matcher.test.js utils/relevance-ranker.test.js
proofUnits.expectedInitialFailure: Functions not found or matching algorithm undefined
proofUnits.expectedPassingEvidence: All tests pass: matching courses ranked correctly, no matches return empty array, scores are 0-1 range

proofUnits.title: Cloud Function Orchestrates Full Pipeline
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: syncVideoToCourses Cloud Function processes video through extraction → matching → ranking → Firestore write
proofUnits.exactCommand: cd functions && npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions:syncVideoToCourses; manually trigger with test video in Firebase Console; check logs and Firestore
proofUnits.expectedInitialFailure: Deployment fails or execution errors in logs or no Firestore document written
proofUnits.expectedPassingEvidence: Function deploys, executes without error, logs show extraction and ranking steps, document in videoCourseMappings with videoId and courses array

proofUnits.title: videoId Tracking Prevents Re-Processing
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: Sync skips videos already processed; admin re-sync button can force re-processing
proofUnits.exactCommand: npm test -- src/syncVideoToCourses.test.js --grep 'videoId tracking'; manually trigger sync twice for same video; verify skip on second run
proofUnits.expectedInitialFailure: videoId check not implemented; every video processed every time
proofUnits.expectedPassingEvidence: Unit test passes, second run logs 'Skipping: video already synced', re-sync button forces new processing

proofUnits.title: Admin Page Displays Unmatched Videos
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: Admin page shows list of videos with no matched courses, with filters and sort options
proofUnits.exactCommand: Open /admin page in browser; navigate to Unmatched Videos section; verify list populated, filters work, sort works
proofUnits.expectedInitialFailure: Section missing, list empty when unmatched videos exist, data doesn't populate
proofUnits.expectedPassingEvidence: Section visible, list shows videos where hasCourses=false, filters and pagination work, re-sync button available

proofUnits.title: API Status Indicator Shows on Admin Page
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: Green/red indicator shows Aesop API status; updates based on sync outcomes
proofUnits.exactCommand: Open admin page; locate status indicator; trigger sync; observe indicator change (green for OK, red for error)
proofUnits.expectedInitialFailure: Indicator not visible or doesn't update
proofUnits.expectedPassingEvidence: Indicator present, shows current status (green/red), updates in real-time based on sync

proofUnits.title: Email Alert Sent on API Failure
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: When API is down, sync processor sends email to ravenshroud@gmail.com with error details
proofUnits.exactCommand: Trigger sync with invalid API endpoint; check email inbox within 1-2 min; or check Cloud Function logs for 'Email alert sent'
proofUnits.expectedInitialFailure: Email not sent or error handler not triggered
proofUnits.expectedPassingEvidence: Email received with timestamp and error message, or log shows email sent successfully
proofUnits.waiverGuidance: Accept log evidence if email testing not feasible

proofUnits.title: End-to-End Sync Against Real Videos
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: Sync processor runs against 5-10 real curated videos; all are processed with relevant courses matched and ranked correctly
proofUnits.exactCommand: Query curatedVideos collection for 5 test videos; manually trigger syncVideoToCourses for each; verify videoCourseMappings documents: videoId matches, courses array populated, scores descending, titles semantically relevant
proofUnits.expectedInitialFailure: Videos not processed, empty courses array, irrelevant courses, scores unordered
proofUnits.expectedPassingEvidence: All 5 videos processed, 4+ had matching courses, rankings appear correct, zero errors
proofUnits.waiverGuidance: Manual spot-check sufficient; Scott approves ranking quality
